kzhr.name: Kzhr
kzhr.description: The edge resists ordinary dulling and minor chipping.

vhrket.name: Vhr'ket
vhrket.description: Suppresses sound produced directly by the object.

ulk.name: Ulk
ulk.description: Reduces effective carried weight by roughly one third without changing volume.

qhess.name: Qhess
qhess.description: Greatly slows heat transfer through the item.

nhar.name: Nhar
nhar.description: Greatly slows body heat loss through the item.

tzkhal.name: Tz'khal
tzkhal.description: Stabilizes applied poisons, tranquilizers, and other coatings.

ghram.name: Ghram
ghram.description: Disperses part of a sudden physical impact and reduces blunt trauma.

ssekh.name: Ssekh
ssekh.description: Resists soaking, mud, blood, and ordinary staining.

xhr.name: Xhr
xhr.description: Makes the item harder to wrench from its attuned bearer.

dhekk.name: Dhekk
dhekk.description: Preserves container contents against ordinary spoilage and degradation.

rrekh.name: Rr'ekh
rrekh.description: Reacts visibly to nearby mana; stronger sources produce a stronger reaction.

khtzh.name: Kh'tzh
khtzh.description: Slowly repairs small cracks and deformation while unused; it cannot regenerate missing material.
